question: Select the synonym of Deteriorate.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Worsen**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Deteriorate"** means to become progressively worse or decline in quality, condition, or value. (बिगड़ना)

 
 
• **Example:** The condition of the old building began to deteriorate due to lack of maintenance.
 
 
 
• **"Worsen"** refers to a state where something becomes worse or less satisfactory than before. (खराब होना)
 
 
• **Example:** His health started to worsen after he ignored the doctor’s advice.
 
 
 
• Hence, "Worsen" is the synonym of "Deteriorate".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Worsen**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Grow** (बढ़ना): To increase in size, amount, or intensity.

 
 
• **Example:** The plants grow faster during the rainy season.
 
 
 
• **Revive** (पुनर्जीवित करना): To restore to life or consciousness; to regain vitality.
 
 
• **Example:** The new policies helped revive the struggling economy.
 
 
 
• **Improve** (सुधारना): To make something better or enhance its quality.
 
 
• **Example:** She worked hard to improve her grades in school.
